title: Reproducibility materials for Multifunctional structures can persist while barriers to division of labor change
description: Reproducibility materials accompanying the theory manuscript 'Multifunctional structures can persist while barriers to division of labor change'. The package contains the manuscript source, supporting theory, figure sources, executable model/process implementation, claim verifier, regression tests, anonymity audit, and checksum manifest. The manuscript asks how the selective barrier preventing structural division of labor can change while a multifunctional phenotype remains visible, linking architecture value, evolutionary accessibility, and rare establishment to changing resistance to reorganization.
